properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-25: "Go with a + b, then c". This is option a of fact:root-cause-a-fix-rarely-records-what-it-answered-because-it-is-a-separate-call-2026-10-25: add_change_event takes `answers`, a list of finding ids (each with an optional note for a partial answer, as `invalidates` already allows), and draws INVALIDATES from the change to each in the same call. A change of type defect_fix or test_failure_fix that answers nothing reads as one line in loop_status, until it names what it answered or says it answered none. `invalidates` stays for answering a finding after the fact. Additive: no tool is removed.
properties.name: A fix's change record names the findings it answers in the same call (add_change_event `answers`), and a defect fix that answers nothing is a loop line (built 2026-10-25: cap:a-fix-names-the-findings-it-answers-in-the-same-call)
properties.rationale: What a tool does in the same call gets done: CAUSES rides record_finding and is drawn (353), while INVALIDATES is a second call and is drawn about 4 times in 10 (233). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
